scope: Raw-result availability and provenance only. No model probabilities or provider forecasts are included. Pre-poll zero scaffolds do not demonstrate live counting reliability.

watchlist.competitive_definition: Exact membership in the frozen watchlist; no probability values copied into this audit.

definitions.selected_scope: Exactly the published snapshot selection; county, contest or partial. One coherent total per race.
definitions.available_county_fields: Available accepted county detail, counted separately per source. Does not establish complete geography or permit adding sources together. Zero CivicAPI subsets are not validated complete manifests.
definitions.direct_baseline_available: Snapshot has_baseline flag only. Does not establish enough counted votes or eligibility for a direct measurement.
definitions.canonical_race_key: At-large AK/DE/ND/SD/VT/WY -01 or -00 aliases normalize to -AL for source matching.
definitions.selected_source_urls: Resolved raw download URLs, pipe-separated in the same order as selected_source_ids.
definitions.model_gate_reason: Snapshot reason for withholding/using direct observation; contains no forecast estimate.

first_network_sweep.context: First expanded network sweep, superseded by fixes and recovery. Not the final coverage audit.

final_network_refresh.context: Subsequent network refresh using existing historical caches and in-interval source reuse; not a cold benchmark.

archived_input_replay.context: Reparsed immutable archived raw and companion metadata, without network. RSS unavailable because sandbox denied the timing utility sysctl; no RSS claim.

verification.browser: Desktop and 375px mobile checked; no horizontal overflow; source accordion verified.
verification.archive_hashes: Every recorded raw, metadata, version and baseline hash verified against stored bytes.
verification.snapshot_source_hashes: Every source hash set matches the final snapshot input_hashes.

limitations: All accepted current vote counts are zero; no race has a direct observation. This is a pre-poll availability check.
Raw coverage expanded to the whole board, but 44 races have historical direct baselines, including 16 competitive races. Direct model gates remain unchanged.
CivicAPI and PollingDesk share CivicAPI as upstream. They are delivery alternatives, not independent corroboration.
PollingDesk CSV lacks explicit election-date and test-data fields. It is a pinned 2026 general-election catalog, lower-priority aggregate raw display only.
Sixty CivicAPI full-race feeds validated election/state/race identity and explicit test_data=false. Available zero county subsets do not prove complete geography.
The development prior is dated 2026-10-21T07:00:35-04:00 and is stale for public election-day operation.
Collection remains disabled by default; this branch has not been deployed.

known_source_findings.finding: Actual official XML has IsTest=true; rejected and unavailable until a production payload validates.
Final collector failed TLS certificate verification: unable to get local issuer certificate. No official PDF counts accepted; TLS verification remains enabled.
HTTP/parser succeeded but every inspected House contest is NR. No vote total substituted; secondary fallback supplies raw coverage.
First sweep timed out; successful validated official fetch recovered before the final snapshot.
Initial encoding incompatibility was fixed; final official county CSV plus metadata parsed successfully.
FL-10 absent from official current export; missing contest is not zero or a call. Whole-board fallback covers its display.
